queries: OpenAI superalignment 20% compute promised four years May 2024 team resources Jan Leike

sources_considered.why: Primary statement of the pledge, including its four-year duration.
Contemporary reporting reproducing the former team co-leader's account of compute shortages.
Read in full. Its anonymous-source reporting is relevant, but does not remove the missing allocation schedule or make the qualified statement binary.

evidence_items.explanation: The likely underlying pledge concerns secured compute over four years. It does not specify an allocation required by May 2024.

metric_scope.metric: Share of compute secured as of the announcement committed to superintelligence alignment over four years

evidence_items.locator: Story text, paragraph quoting Jan Leike's resignation thread

receipt.public_excerpt: Sometimes we were struggling for compute and it was getting harder and harder to get this crucial research done.

evidence_items.explanation: Leike's reported account gives a contemporary basis for concern about access to compute. This news reproduction of his testimony supplies neither an allocation percentage nor a due date.

unresolved_gaps: The wording does not establish which resources count or what allocation was due by publication.
The cited testimony does not quantify resources delivered against a defined schedule.
A binary verdict would require converting a qualified allegation into a firmer claim.
